title: VLT (Very Large Telescope) HD Timelapse Footage
summary: A timelapse compilation of the night sky above the Very Large Telescope at Paranal, Chile, using ESO photographers' footage set to music. It shows the stars wheeling overhead and the observatory at work.
why: Commenters recommend it as an awe-inspiring way to feel Earth's rotation and our place in space.

quote.text: the first time I really grasped that we're all together on a rock tumbling through the vastness of space
